character: Thermal spa town in the valley. 30-50% cheaper than altitude resorts. Access to 3V via Olympe gondola.
description: Brides-les-Bains is the budget secret of the Three Valleys. A thermal spa town at 600m in the valley floor, it's 30-50% cheaper than staying in Méribel or Courchevel. The Olympe gondola whisks you up to Méribel in 20 minutes. The Grand Spa Thermal (2,700 sqm) is one of France's largest — hammam, sauna, steam baths, 18m pool, 4 jacuzzis. 50+ hours/week of free entertainment.

weather_snow.note: Skiing is at altitude via gondola. Brides itself is low-altitude.

villages.name: Brides-les-Bains
villages.character: Thermal spa town, budget accommodation, funicular to Méribel

non_ski_activities.grand_spa_thermal: 2,700 m² — one of largest thermal spas in the Alps. 170 years of spa tradition. Hammam, sauna, steam baths, 18m leisure pool, 25m swimming corridor, 4 jacuzzis (2 indoor/2 outdoor), bubble beds, underwater jets, swan necks. Specialises in weight management, rheumatic care.
non_ski_activities.wellness_breaks: 3-5 day wellness breaks available. Dietetic conferences, healthy cooking workshops, adapted sports, health education. France's only Label Diététique certified destination.
dining: Relief (craft beer bar — craft beers, tapas, cocktails)
non_ski_activities.entertainment: 50+ hours/week free: yoga, pilates, guided walks, open-air cinema, concerts, DJ sets
non_ski_activities.access: Olympe gondola to Méribel in 20 mins (newly renovated 2021). 30-50% cheaper than altitude resorts.

honest_drawbacks: Must take gondola to reach skiing — can't ski to/from accommodation
Valley floor can be wet when snow is low
